memberdef.argsstring: (GLFWwindow *window, int32_t button, int32_t action, int32_t mods)
memberdef.name: mlx_mouse_cb

detaileddescription.para: This function sets the scroll callback, which is called when a scrolling device is used, such as a mouse wheel.
This function sets the mouse callback, which is called when a mouse does any sort of action such as pressing a key.
This function sets the cursor callback, which is called when the mouse position changes. Position is relative to the window.
Checks whether a mouse button is pressed or not.

parameterdescription.para: A specific mouse key. e.g MLX_MOUSE_BUTTON_0

simplesect.para: True or false if the mouse key is down or not.

detaileddescription.para: Returns the current, relative, mouse cursor position on the window, starting from the top left corner.
Negative values or values greater than window width or height indicate that it is outside the window.
